scope: Read official Cinnamon architecture/PID articles and follow the RPC middleware link to yarpc. GitHub repository searches for cinnamon in uber, uber-go and yarpc, and code searches in uber, uber-go and yarpc/yarpc-go returned zero matches. This bounded search covers GitHub-indexed public repositories/code, not private code, unindexed files or every organization; it does not prove no usable implementation exists elsewhere.
direct_comparison: Not performed: an official runnable implementation was not identified in the bounded search. No recreated approximation is labeled Cinnamon.
reference_policy: No independent reimplementation is presented as Uber Cinnamon.
